$description: Icon names used in this project, grouped by Iconify set prefix (each needs its @iconify-json/<prefix> package as a devDependency). Lucide names (https://lucide.dev/icons) are used as-is, e.g. <Icon name={'x'} />, and other sets as prefix:name, e.g. <Icon name={'mdi:home'} />. scripts/icons-generate.mjs builds icons.ts from this list on dev / build, so only these icons are bundled. npm run dev rebuilds it automatically when this file changes.
